purpose: Prevent stale directional/context analysis from being paired with fresh event evidence to create a formally valid live-shadow request.
event_state_rule: decision_input.risk_modifiers.event_state must be AUTO_OFFICIAL or absent; no manual event state is permitted in a first-real-capable draft.
quote_rule: Draft remains quote-free. Exact Micro price/timestamp is never supplied by the draft or preparer.
reuse_rule: A committed draft may be used only while its analysis_frozen_at_taipei remains within the 900-second gate. After expiry, a new analysis draft is required; do not simply refresh the timestamp.
